gaps: Lab missing for Mixtral 8x7B and T5 (the text never names their lab). Release timeline 2023 to Sep 2026: only 6 records date before 2026 (Mixtral 8x7B 2023, DeepSeek-V3 end of 2024, Llama 3 2024, DeepSeek R1 2025, T5 2019, GPT-3 2020), and the pre-2026 ones are year-only, mostly from related-paper years rather than release dates. Nothing at all is dated in 2025 apart from R1; nothing dated Jan to Jul 2026.
28 of 34 releases fall between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30 (a seven-week window), so a 2023 to 2026 timeline would be almost empty except for its last two months.

Every 2026 day-month date ('Aug 26', 'Sep 22' etc.) has an inferred year; only DeepSeek V4.1-Flash ('September 2026'), Gemini 3.8 Live ('Sep 2026') and Muse Glimmer (Aug 10, inferred) anchor the year explicitly or nearly so.

Many models named on the page have no date: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra, gpt-oss, Claude Opus 5, Haiku 4.5, Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemma 4, Llama 4, Muse Spark 1.2, DeepSeek V4 Pro/V4 Flash, Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, Qwen3.8-27B, Kimi K3, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M2/M3, Mistral Large 3/Small 4/Medium 3.5, OLMo 3/3.1, Phi-4, Command A, Nova 2, North Small Translate. Also: xAI acquired by SpaceX Feb 2026 and renamed July 2026 (corporate, not releases); GPT-6.1 Astra was withheld on 28 Sep (not released); RLT (Sep 13) is an architecture paper, not a model, and is excluded from releases.

Parameter counts: no closed model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Grok, Muse Spark) has a stated parameter count, so a size axis covers open models only. Dated releases with stated total params: Mixtral, DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3, Muse Glimmer, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, Hy4, Qwen3.8-Max-0902 (2.4T, no active), K2 Horizon (fleet max 375B), V4.1-Flash, Atria Dawn, Bonsai 2, Step 5, MiMo Pro/Flash, Naive-N0.5-Flash.

Open-weight status is null for Step 5 Preview (promised Oct 15, not published), Qwen3.8-Max-0902, MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview, Jev, and the pre-2026 T5/GPT-3/R1 rows; licence is unstated for Hy4, Step 5 and most closed models.

Heatmap: benchmark coverage is very sparse and vendor-specific. Only Terminal-Bench 4.0, DeepSWE v1.1, AutomationBench (unversioned), FrontierCode v1.1, Humanity's Last Exam, GDPval-AA v2.1, Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 and the Tencent blind eval have 3+ models (ARC-AGI-3 has one model in three settings); most models appear on 1 to 4 benchmarks.

Heatmap version traps: Terminal-Bench 4.0 vs 2.1 ('Terminal Bench 2.1' for MiMo), AutomationBench vs AutomationBench 1.0.6, DeepSWE vs DeepSWE v1.1, OSWorld 2.0 vs 2.0 offline vs 2.1, CursorBench 3.2.0 vs 4.0 must not be merged. Fable 5.1's AutomationBench and Terminal-Bench-Science versions vs Opus 5.5's are written identically but the page does not confirm same harness.

Heatmap ambiguities: Opus 5 vs Astra values in Anthropic's table (FrontierCode, HLE, GDPval) are assigned by order of mention only; CursorBench 4.0 46.6% and OSWorld 2.1 74.0% comparators are unnamed and omitted; Step 5's '74.0 to 74.1%' for Astra and Opus 5 is not attributed per model and omitted; MiMo 'loses Terminal-Bench 4.0 to Opus 5 by 14 points' gives no absolute values; Fable 5.1's prior values (24.7, 42.0, 17.1) and Astra's 'prior model' ExploitBench 78.5% have unnamed models and are omitted; GPT-6.1 Sol's AutomationBench 42.2 is derived (Opus 5.5 + 2.2) and its DeepSWE 'matched Astra' has no number because Astra's DeepSWE v1.1 score is not given.

Heatmap: almost every score is vendor-reported; the only independent figures are ARC Prize (Astra ARC-AGI-3 62.7/99.9) and Artificial Analysis (Grok 4.7 TB4.0 33%, Gemini 3.8 Live speech-to-speech 82.6). Units are mixed (%, points, Elo, Codeforces rating, /4 scale).

Scatter: only 9 rows / 8 distinct models have an AA Intelligence Index value (GLM-5.3-Flash 57, Gemini 3.8 Flash 59, Gemini 3.7 Flash 56 derived, GPT-5.6 Sol 59, Grok 4.6 59, Muse Spark 1.3 61/62, MiMo-V2.6-Pro 46, GPT-6 Sol 48), and they come from two incompatible index versions which the page says must not be compared.

Scatter: only 5 models have both an AA index and a price: GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Muse Spark 1.3 (earlier-version group, 3 points) and MiMo-V2.6-Pro, GPT-6 Sol (rescaled group, 2 points). No single-version scatter has more than 3 points; no AA index value is given for any Anthropic model, GPT-6 Astra, Grok 4.7, Gemini 4 Argon, DeepSeek or Kimi K3.
Scatter: Muse Spark 1.3's index version is internally contradictory (called 'reranked v4.2' in one place, and in another the 57 to 62 figures are said to predate v4.2).

Cost per task figures are on different bases: AA Intelligence Index task (GLM-5.3-Flash $0.09, Gemini 3.8 Flash $0.58, Muse Spark 1.3 $0.55, unnamed closed model $2.03), AutomationBench 1.0.6 (GPT-6 Sol $0.27, Opus 5 ~$3.00 derived), an illustrative agent turn (Opus 5.5 $0.22), and whole ARC-AGI-3 runs for Astra ($18,817 / $26,098). Cached prices are missing for Gemini 3.8 Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash, GPT-6 Sol, Luna, Grok 4.7, Gemini 4 Argon; several prices are introductory (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon) or peak-hour (DeepSeek V4.1-Flash).
